# Agent Deck

> Agent Deck is a free, open-source (MIT) terminal session manager for AI coding agents. One TUI shows every Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and other agent session (running, waiting, idle, error) and switches between them with one key. It is a single Go binary built on tmux and Bubble Tea, and runs on macOS, Linux and Windows (WSL).

Agent Deck adds AI awareness on top of tmux: smart status detection, session forking with inherited conversation context, an MCP manager and MCP socket pool, a skills manager, git worktrees, Docker sandboxes, cost tracking, remote SSH instances, a browser web UI, and "conductors" (persistent agent sessions that supervise other sessions and can be reached from Telegram, Slack, Discord or Mattermost). A native macOS app is in development.

Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asheshgoplani/agent-deck/main/install.sh | bash` or `brew install asheshgoplani/tap/agent-deck`, then run `agent-deck`.
